<header><p>Begin with pages 1-3 and the separately supplied Corrected GreenWaste findings. Retain your first draft. Use pages 4-5 for the Copilot Snapshot; hold page 6 until Stage 1 is finished. Complete page 7 independently when instructed.</p><button onclick="window.print()">Print worksheet</button></header>

<div class="sheet-page">

## Page 1 | My first draft, without AI

**Name or identifier:** __________________

Use **Corrected GreenWaste findings F1-F4/T11** and **D11**, separately supplied pages 1-2. This morning's report is not the drafting authority.

**Decision:** national rollout for scores at or below 58 and a proposed 1,800 AED allowance per business; limited next phase or deferral is also possible. Allowance and national total are not measured cost evidence.

Write **connected prose, at most 150 words**. Include:

**Finding and source → action/condition → important limit → next evidence/purpose.**

<div class="writing draft-space"></div>

**Brief body word count:** ___ / 150  
**Sources, on a separate line outside the word limit:**

<div class="writing"></div>

<p class="caption">Work independently before peer review or AI. Keep this version. Count whitespace-separated body words; headings/labels count if included in the body. The worked model is deliberately not printed on this drafting sheet.</p>

</div>

<div class="sheet-page">

## Page 2 | My partner checks the source

**Author:** __________ **Reviewer:** __________

For each check write an exact sentence/source or an omission. Use **Supported / Revise / Missing**, with a reason; a tick or number match is not enough.

```{r, results='asis'}
html_out(paste0('<table class="reading-table peer-table"><thead><tr><th>Check</th><th>Sentence/source, rating and reason</th></tr></thead><tbody>',
  paste(sprintf('<tr><td>%s</td><td>________________________</td></tr>',d11_peer),collapse=''),
  '</tbody></table>'))
```

</div>

**8 minutes.** Prepared illustrative response, not a captured live transcript.

```

```

Keep one defensible sentence. Correct two unsupported assurances. Identify one material omission and its decision consequence. Use F1-F4, not AI confidence.

## Page 5 | Copilot Snapshot, Stage 2

**7 minutes.** Use Copilot if available/approved; otherwise use page 6 after Stage 1. Paste only this fictional case and your brief prose, not identifiers or scores.

### A decision-focused prompt

```{r, results='asis'}
html_out(paste0('<p class="prompt">',d11_prompt,'</p>'))
```

**Source bundle:** separately supplied Corrected GreenWaste findings, pages 1-2: D11, F1-F4 and Table T11.

**I used:** Copilot / prepared paper alternative

### Compare with my own draft

One substantive change, its source and its effect on the advice:

<div class="writing tall"></div>

One claim or omission I still need to verify, and how:

<div class="writing tall"></div>

**Output body word count:** ___ / 150 **Sources separated?** Yes / No

<p class="caption">Answer at most two clarifying questions briefly. If the response is slow, use the prepared alternative without extending the task. No second chat is required. Word count is a format check, not a source-faithfulness judgement.</p>

</div>

<div class="sheet-page">

## Page 6 | Prepared paper alternative

**Hold until Stage 1 is finished.** Use for Stage 2 when Copilot is unavailable, slow or not approved. This is authored training material, not additional evidence.

### Clarifying questions

```{r, results='asis'}
html_out(paste0('<p>',d11_fallback[1],'</p>'))
```

### One possible conditional revision

```{r, results='asis'}
html_out(paste0('<div class="ai-source"><p>',d11_fallback[2],'</p></div><p class="caption">',d11_fallback[3],'</p>'))
```

The source line is outside the brief's 150-word body. The action is one defensible option, not a required vote.

### Verify it against F1-F4
